categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi Xinhongye Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialty cables including new energy vehicle cables, charging pile cables, photovoltaic cables, energy storage cables, rail transit cables, nuclear power cables and penetrations, marine cables, and robot cables. These products serve various high-tech and emerging industries such as new energy vehicles, photovoltaics, nuclear power, rail transit, marine engineering, and robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as cross-linked polyethylene elastomer insulation, liquid-cooled high-power charging cables, high-frequency electromagnetic interference shielding, and composite conductor materials including aluminum alloy and copper alternatives. Production methods include precise twisting, irradiation cross-linking, and multi-layer shielding to meet stringent performance standards like high temperature resistance, radiation resistance, and mechanical flexibility. The company also emphasizes R&D collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners to innovate materials and cable structures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading new energy vehicle manufacturers (e.g., BYD, Geely, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto), photovoltaic module producers (e.g., Jinko Solar, Canadian Solar, Trina Solar), nuclear power engineering firms, rail transit equipment manufacturers, marine shipbuilders, and robotics companies. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international clients, focusing on sectors with high technical requirements and growth potential in clean energy and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It serves domestic markets extensively, especially in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other major industrial clusters. The company also exports products internationally and maintains strategic partnerships with global customers and certification bodies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wuxi Xinhongye operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of specialty cables and related components. It procures raw materials such as copper wire and chemical compounds upstream and supplies finished cable products downstream to OEMs and system integrators in new energy, photovoltaic, nuclear, rail transit, marine, and robotics industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-voltage and high-frequency cables for new energy vehicles, liquid-cooled ultra-fast charging cables, lightweight aluminum conductor cables, and radiation-resistant nuclear cables. It invests heavily in R&D to develop advanced insulation materials, flexible and integrated cable solutions for robotics and low-altitude economy applications, and participates in international projects like the ITER nuclear fusion experiment. The strategy includes strengthening industry standards leadership, expanding global market presence, and deepening collaborations with research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialty cable products to industrial customers in new energy vehicles, photovoltaics, energy storage, rail transit, nuclear power, marine, and robotics sectors. The company employs a pricing model linked to copper prices plus processing fees, reflecting raw material cost fluctuations. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including contracts and orders from OEMs and system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech specialty cable manufacturer in China with strong market share in new energy vehicle cables and photovoltaic cables. It competes with domestic and international cable manufacturers but differentiates itself through advanced technology, comprehensive certifications, and strategic partnerships with top-tier customers. It holds a national high-tech enterprise status and is recognized as a key player in setting industry standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.65 billion, representing a 32.33% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 116.26 million, a decline of 29.61% compared to the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 4.25 billion, up 25.69%. The company has shown strong revenue growth driven by expanding new energy and photovoltaic markets, despite some profit margin pressure. R&D expenses increased by 34.4%, reflecting strategic investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wuxi Xinhongye emphasizes high-performance, durable, and technologically advanced specialty cables tailored for demanding applications in new energy vehicles, photovoltaics, nuclear power, and robotics. Its products feature superior temperature resistance, electromagnetic interference shielding, radiation resistance, and mechanical flexibility. The company’s value proposition includes comprehensive certifications, customized solutions, integration with cutting-edge technologies like liquid cooling and composite materials, and strong customer collaboration to meet evolving industry standards and application needs.
